about: The arena in Megabuilding H10, one row per placed thing, made in game with the layout editor (CET overlay > Cyberpunk Kino layout) and copied from layout.json. A player's own layout.json overrides these rows.

columns.kind: start | barricade | wallbuy | box | spawn | stash
columns.zone: barricade: the zone it closes (buying it opens zone+1); spawn: the zone it belongs to (active once open); others: the zone they stand in
columns.weapon: wallbuy: weapons sheet id; others: none
columns.inside_x: barricade: X of the side V stands on (where a push sends V); others: where V stood
columns.entity: stash: the stash's EntityID hash as CET prints it (e.g. 123ULL); others: none
